body.title: Default-branch resolution and pin verification
body.summary: Implement the refresh's branch decision: parse git ls-remote --symref output (the remote's answer wins over any pin), fall back to the branch recorded in a valid sighting, then to a supplied --branch name verified with git ls-remote --heads (non-empty output) and recorded with source user, otherwise refuse with the instruction to re-run with --branch; an unreachable remote or a missing branch records nothing.
acceptanceChecks: The remote's named default branch is used and overrides an earlier user pin; the supplied name is ignored.
With a dangling remote HEAD and no pin the result is a refusal asking for --branch.
A supplied branch is accepted only when ls-remote --heads prints it; a missing branch or an unreachable remote returns a reason and records nothing.

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/branch-resolution.test.ts: the remote's answer wins over a supplied branch, then the sighting's branch, then the supplied branch after verification
src/workflow/team/__tests__/branch-resolution.test.ts: a dangling remote HEAD is refused without --branch and a real branch is recorded with source user
src/workflow/team/__tests__/branch-resolution.test.ts: a missing branch name or an unreachable remote records nothing
